paragraphs.text: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH — FINAL ARCHITECTURE BASELINEThis document is the governing product, calculator, entitlement, certification, publication, UX, platform, roadmap and catalogue architecture for CalcuMint. Future implementation must conform to it unless a change is explicitly approved, documented and incorporated into a later controlled revision.

One Final calculator. One authoritative deterministic engine. Identical mathematical correctness for everyone. Free calculates; Pro analyzes and optimizes; Business collaborates, deploys and automates.

Architecture date: 1 October 2026Status: FINAL / GOVERNING BASELINESupersedes fragmented V1/V2/V3 customer-facing product conceptsDoes not itself authorize production deployment or bypass certification
Single future-reference specification for the complete CalcuMint product and calculator architecture.
Architecture baseline for product, engineering, UX, catalogue, entitlements, certification and publication decisions.
Every legitimately published calculator is a Final Calculator. No customer-facing V1/V2/V3 calculator release cycle.
Immutable numeric/internal revisions remain available for auditability, certification, reproducibility and publication identity.
Repository definitions/tests/migrations and authoritative production database state control runtime certification/publication; this blueprint controls architecture and policy.
Material changes require an explicit decision record and controlled blueprint revision. No silent architectural drift.
This document is a build target, not production authorization. CI, certification, security, YMYL and publication gates remain mandatory.
This Final Master Blueprint & Product Architecture is the architecture and product-policy authority.
The Master Calculator Catalog is the governed portfolio/planning inventory and entitlement mapping.
Certified repository calculator definitions and deterministic tests are the mathematical source of truth.
Authoritative database lifecycle/publication records determine what is legitimately public.
Current regulatory sources and certified rule packs govern jurisdiction-sensitive calculators.
When a conflict is discovered, it must be reconciled explicitly; no source may be silently overwritten merely to make states appear consistent.
PERMANENT PRODUCT RULEFree calculates. Pro understands, compares, optimizes and remembers. Business builds, brands, collaborates and automates. Mathematical correctness is never a paid feature.
One canonical calculator URL and identity; plans change capabilities, not formulas or page identity.
Every public calculator must be certified and published through the governed lifecycle before it may be called Final.
Final is a customer-facing product/completeness state; technical revision is an internal audit identity.
Charts, schedules, exports, scenarios, sensitivity and AI explanations consume deterministic engine output and must not independently reimplement formulas.
No plan may receive a more accurate mathematical answer than another plan.
High-stakes financial, health, tax and other regulated calculators retain specialist/reviewer gates where required.
2. Final Product Doctrine: Final vs Technical Revision
Appendix B. Master Calculator Catalog (540-item planning inventory)
Appendix C. Competitive Research Source Register

CalcuMint will move directly from its certified deterministic calculation foundation to a Final Calculator Experience. There is no customer-facing V2/V3 calculator release cycle. Existing certified formulas remain authoritative unless a verified formula defect, methodology change or rule update requires a controlled technical revision and recertification.

CalcuMint is a global calculation intelligence platform, not merely a directory of isolated tools. Its defensible value comes from deterministic trust, visual explanation, reverse solving, scenario modelling, sensitivity analysis, decision journeys, global rule packs, saved work, professional outputs, and Business deployment capabilities.
Every public result is deterministic, tested, certified and reconciled across headline results, cards, charts, tables, scenarios and exports.
Free users receive a complete core calculation and useful basic visualization where appropriate.
Pro monetizes analysis, Goal Solver, scenarios, sensitivity, persistence, exports and richer explanation—not correctness.
Business monetizes teams, clients, calculator builder, branding, embeds, API, batch, webhooks and governance.
No mass publication of thin, uncertified or draft calculators merely to increase page count.
Country/rule-sensitive calculators use explicit jurisdiction, rule-pack revision, effective dates, authoritative sources and review evidence.
2. Final Product Doctrine: Final vs Technical Revision

The word Final is the public product state for a calculator that has passed all required gates. It is not a replacement for internal technical versioning. Internal revision identifiers remain immutable and auditable.
Certified, governed, publishable customer product experience.
Prominent: Final / Formula verified / Rules verified as appropriate.
Immutable calculation-engine revision used for lineage and reproducibility.
Internal change identity for formula or rounding changes.
Visible for regulated tools where decision-relevant.

A material improvement never creates “Calculator V2” for customers. It creates a new internal technical revision, runs the complete certification gate, and—only after approval—becomes the active published revision of the same Final Calculator at the same canonical URL. Previous revisions remain historical/auditable rather than silently mutating.

CUSTOMER-FACING RULEDo not show “Version 1”, “V1”, “V2” or “V3” as the calculator product release. Use Final trust terminology. Numeric technical revision may be disclosed under Methodology for auditability.
The permanent execution and presentation pipeline is:
CalculatorDefinition → Certified Compute Engine → StructuredCalculationResult → PresentationDefinition → FinalCalculatorRenderer → EntitlementResolver
Typed inputs, units, validation, formulas, rounding, risk class, sources, jurisdiction metadata and immutable technical revision.
Pure deterministic computation. No network dependency and no plan-specific formula forks.
Normalized headline result, metrics, series, composition, schedules, ranges, reverse targets, assumptions, warnings and metadata.
Declares presentation family and which reusable visual/analysis components are mathematically meaningful.
Consistent responsive experience rendered from contracts rather than bespoke pages.
Centrally resolves Free/Pro/Business capabilities as active, previewed, locked or unavailable.
Save history, projects, scenarios, teams and audit state without changing computation.
API, embed, batch, webhooks, branding and governance around the same certified engine.

ONE ENGINE, THREE EXPERIENCESThe calculation result exists independently of subscription. Subscription controls additional analysis, persistence, collaboration and deployment capabilities around that result.
Each calculator has a stable canonical calculator ID and slug.
Inputs are typed and carry units, validation, defaults, precision and classification metadata.
Formula logic is deterministic and testable without network access.
Rounding policy is explicit and part of certification.
Risk class and jurisdiction requirements are declared in metadata.
Sources and methodology are part of the governed definition for source-dependent calculators.
Internal technical revision is immutable for a released calculation identity.
Plan/entitlement logic does not live inside the mathematical compute path.
Required to perform the basic calculation.
Always available when calculator is available.
Needed for a materially correct answer in the user’s situation.

Recommended next calculations in the user’s decision path.

RECONCILIATION INVARIANTFor identical inputs, headline result, chart terminal value, schedule terminal value, scenario baseline and export value must agree within the calculator’s explicit rounding policy.

Domain and presentation family are separate. Domain controls discovery, SEO, editorial taxonomy and journeys. Presentation family controls reusable UX and analysis behavior. This separation is required to scale without thousands of bespoke interfaces.

Calculate action with clear validation and accessible errors.

MOBILE-FIRST RULEOn mobile, the answer appears before long explanations and before upgrade messaging. Charts are responsive, detailed schedules may begin summarized, and the page never requires horizontal page scrolling.

All plans use the same Final calculator and authoritative engine. Entitlements are feature capabilities, centrally resolved. They must not be scattered as ad-hoc plan checks through calculator-specific components.
Complete core calculation and useful interpretation.
Advertising and acquisition; no reduction in correctness.
Advanced analysis, reverse solving, scenarios, sensitivity, persistence, exports, richer explanation, ad-free experience.
Build, brand, collaborate, deploy and automate.
Teams, clients, builder, embeds, API, batch, webhooks, branding and governance.
Mathematical correctness, required safety warnings, required assumptions and authoritative sources are never paid features.
Any input required for correctness or jurisdiction selection remains available to Free users.
Pro may add optional analytical variables, but not hide variables required for a materially correct core answer.
Free visualizations must be useful, not intentionally misleading or truncated to create an accuracy disadvantage.
Business limits may control throughput, collaboration and deployment—not formula quality.
Entitlement tests must prove cross-plan equality of the authoritative primary calculation for identical inputs.
Solve supported variables against a target using certified forward compute; verify the reverse solution by feeding it back into the forward engine.
Each scenario is a complete deterministic input set; baseline must equal the normal calculator for identical inputs.
Sweep declared variables/ranges through the certified engine; never use an independent approximate formula unless explicitly certified.
Derived from engine outputs and reconciled to headline totals/terminal values.
Serialize the same structured result and assumptions used on screen.
Grounded in structured result, methodology and assumptions; cannot create a competing numeric result.
Business is not merely Pro with higher limits. It is the organizational and deployment layer around the same Final calculators.
Custom calculator builder constrained to deterministic/auditable definitions
Brand configuration and white-label presentation where permitted
Lead capture only where transparent and appropriate
Last reviewed date and source/rule metadata where relevant

The prominent trust area communicates customer-relevant confidence: Final release state, Formula verified, deterministic calculation, and Rules verified where applicable. It does not market internal revision numbers as product releases.

Methodology retains formula, assumptions, rounding policy, technical calculation revision, rule-pack revision where applicable, review date, certification/source metadata and authoritative references. This preserves reproducibility without exposing V1/V2/V3 product branding.
Unit tests, golden vectors, boundary tests, explicit rounding.
Target solution verified against forward computation.
Chart points derive from deterministic output and reconcile with headline result.
Totals and terminal values reconcile with engine result.
Baseline scenario equals normal calculator for identical inputs.
Variables, ranges and outputs validated; no independent formula drift.
Free/Pro/Business boundaries tested centrally and on page.
Worked example, assumptions, explanation, metadata and sources complete.
Current jurisdiction/rule pack and source evidence where applicable.
Mobile portrait/landscape, desktop, validation and no horizontal overflow.
Keyboard, labels, semantic tables, chart alternatives and contrast.
Charts lazy-loaded where appropriate; interaction remains fast.
Canonical, metadata, indexability, structured content and no thin-page publication.
No client-side entitlement trust; protected actions validated server-side.

PUBLISH RULEA calculator is not Final merely because it renders. It becomes Final only when formula, result presentation, entitlement behavior, required metadata, risk-specific review and authoritative publication lifecycle all pass.

Draft → Review → Certified → Published Final. Publication remains fail-closed. Draft or uncertified calculators are excluded from public discovery. Certification and publication are separate governed acts.
No direct database state manipulation that bypasses lifecycle controls.
No public count target overrides certification quality.
Country/rule-sensitive calculators declare jurisdiction, effective period, rule-pack revision, authoritative sources and review date.
Formula/rule changes create versioned rule packs rather than silent mutation.
Country-specific calculators remain unpublished/index-disabled until rule certification passes.
Financial, health, tax and other designated high-risk calculators require applicable specialist/reviewer evidence before publication.
Currency and units may be localized without altering mathematical correctness.
AI remains assistive and may not override certified rule logic or required warnings.
Describe trade-offs and useful next scenarios.
The canonical flow is Certified Engine → Structured Result → AI Explanation. Never User Inputs → LLM → authoritative mathematical answer.
Journeys are contextual and decision-oriented, not lists of category links. Every Final calculator should connect users to logical next calculations where relevant.

No thin page publication solely for page-count growth.
Unique explanatory content, methodology and sources accompany certified calculators.
Structured metadata must not claim availability or certification that the lifecycle does not authorize.
Keyboard-operable inputs, controls, tabs, scenario tools and dialogs.
Charts require textual/summary alternatives and must not rely on color alone.
No horizontal page scrolling on mobile.
Result appears before long explanations and monetization messaging.
Charts/advanced analysis may lazy-load when appropriate without delaying core calculation.
Performance budgets must preserve fast input-to-result interaction.
Reduced-motion and touch-friendly behavior where applicable.

Typed/versioned deterministic definitions with pure compute and explicit rounding.
Feature/plan/jurisdiction/workspace controls centrally manageable rather than hard-coded per calculator.
Assistive discovery/explanation only; deterministic math remains authoritative.
Never trust client-side plan state for protected actions.
RLS and workspace isolation apply to saved calculations/projects/business data.
API/embed keys are scoped, revocable, rate-limited and auditable.
Billing activation is a separate certified operational decision.
Saved calculations reference canonical calculator identity and exact technical revision used.
Saved inputs, assumptions, result snapshot and relevant rule-pack identity are retained for reproducibility according to product/privacy policy.
Projects group calculations without changing their mathematical engine.
Scenario sets retain baseline and alternatives with explicit assumptions.
Business workspaces add organization ownership, roles and audit trails.
Material formula/rule changes do not silently rewrite historical saved results.
All delivery modes call the same certified engine contract as the web calculator.
API response includes calculator identity, technical revision, inputs/assumptions, deterministic result and warnings appropriate to the endpoint.
Batch execution is bounded, metered and idempotent where applicable.
Embeds preserve certification/trust and cannot alter authoritative formula logic client-side.
Webhooks are signed, retry-safe and auditable.
Business branding may change presentation but not source/methodology integrity or mandatory risk disclosures.

These six are internal framework references, not a customer-facing V2 release. They prove that the shared contracts support amortization, growth, general accumulation, complex consumer decisions, range-based UX and business crossover/sensitivity without calculator-specific architectural hacks.

All six must reconcile headline/chart/table/scenario outputs, behave correctly on mobile and desktop, preserve Free mathematical completeness, expose meaningful Pro differentiation, and retain Business as workflow/deployment capability rather than an accuracy upgrade.

Portfolio counts are planning ranges, never publication quotas. The controlling rule is certification quality. The architecture targets approximately 250–400 high-quality certified calculators as the first mature foundation, then expands through governed factory processes.
High-value domains, Final UX, journeys, strong SEO and trust.
Broader domain coverage, more countries/rule packs, deeper Pro workflows.
Biology, earth/astronomy, specialist professional and deeper technical tools.
Factory-driven creation, governance, localization, APIs, embeds and business automation.

Scale comes from reusable contracts and governed metadata, not copy-pasted pages. A calculator factory may accelerate definition scaffolding, tests, presentation mapping and editorial structure, but cannot bypass certification.

No reference calculator exposes a structural gap requiring bespoke renderer architecture.
Accessibility and performance are acceptable for production scale.
CI and certification suites are green.
Customer-facing release terminology is Final; numeric technical revisions are confined to Methodology/audit contexts.

For a fixed calculator technical revision and identical accuracy-required inputs, Free, Pro and Business must produce the same authoritative primary result and required safety interpretation. Tests should compare engine outputs directly rather than relying only on rendered text.
Freeze this blueprint as the governing implementation baseline.
Develop only on an isolated Final Framework branch; keep production main unchanged during framework construction.

Build the reusable Final Calculator Renderer and component library.

Implement centralized Free/Pro/Business feature resolution and contextual previews.
Run formula, reconciliation, entitlement, responsive, accessibility, performance, SEO and security QA.
Review Reference Six visually/functionally before catalog migration.
Map existing certified calculators to domains and presentation families; migrate by family.
Certify every migrated calculator against the Final publish gate.
Only after approval and green CI use controlled merge/deployment steps.
Continue catalog expansion based on user value and decision journeys, never raw count.
Production build remains next build --webpack unless an explicitly governed architecture change replaces it.
No merge solely because UI looks complete; certification and CI evidence are required.
No weakening of certified-only public gate or authoritative publication lifecycle.
No Paddle production activation as part of calculator-framework work.
No DNS/infrastructure change unless separately approved.
No chart/table computation that bypasses certified engine.

The architecture is grounded first in CalcuMint project sources. Competitor research is used to identify capability patterns, not to copy product logic. The strongest opportunities identified in the supplied research are deterministic trust/certification, reverse solving, visual result intelligence, scenarios/sensitivity, persistence, Business builder/embed/API, global rule packs, decision journeys and mobile-first UX.
Versioned deterministic engine + golden/boundary tests + certified-only public gate
Goal Solver/reverse solving as reusable Pro capability
Reverse result must reconcile to forward engine
Free basic visualization; advanced charts/sensitivity Pro
Baseline scenario must equal normal calculation
Business API, batch jobs, webhooks, governance
Regulated calculators require authoritative sources + review date
Journey links must stay relevant, not SEO-only
AI Finder + result explanation grounded in structured deterministic output
AI never produces competing calculation result
Unique editorial content per certified calculator
No thin pages; canonical URL per calculator
Appendix A. Governing Plan Entitlement Matrix
This appendix is a quick-reference entitlement baseline. Product packaging may adjust limits, quotas or commercial terms without changing the locked accuracy and capability principles.
Appendix B. Master Calculator Catalog Governance

The supplied Master Calculator Catalog contains 540 planning entries across 27 catalog domains in its snapshot. The catalog remains the governed portfolio inventory; this blueprint governs how every catalog item must be designed, entitled, certified and published. The catalog workbook is a controlled companion data asset rather than duplicated row-for-row here, preventing the architecture bible from silently diverging from the maintained inventory.

CATALOG AUTHORITY RULEThe Master Calculator Catalog controls portfolio inventory and planning status. Repository definitions/tests control implemented mathematical behavior. Authoritative lifecycle/publication state controls what is public. No planning row becomes Final merely because it exists in the catalog.
Appendix C. Competitive Research Source Register
In-house development/testing; financial advisor review claim

Android app, pinned/recent tools, 3700+ app library

Pro pricing/features, AI chat, no ads, storage
Graphing, points of interest, audio trace
Subjects, free step-by-step positioning, app photo input, trial
Mortgage calculators, comparison tools and amortization
Advanced details, graph/summary, fact-checking, advisor CTA

A customer-facing calculator that has passed required certification and authoritative publication gates.
Immutable internal identifier for exact deterministic calculation lineage; not customer release branding.
Normalized data contract consumed by UI, charts, exports, scenarios and AI explanation.
Reusable UX/analysis behavior independent of discovery domain.
Capability access decision for Free, Pro or Business.
Versioned jurisdiction/effective-period rules and source metadata.
High-stakes category requiring applicable specialist/reviewer governance.
Proof that multiple presentations of the same calculation agree within rounding policy.
Single public calculator route shared across plan experiences.
One Final calculator identity per canonical calculator URL.
One authoritative deterministic calculation engine per technical revision.
No customer-facing V1/V2/V3 calculator product releases.
Internal technical revisions remain immutable and auditable.
Free, Pro and Business mathematical correctness is identical.
Accuracy-required inputs and safety information are never paywalled.
Pro monetizes analytical depth and persistence.
Business monetizes organizational workflow, integration and deployment.
All derived views reconcile to deterministic output.
AI cannot become the authoritative calculation engine.
Certification and authoritative publication remain fail-closed.
Risk-specific review gates cannot be bypassed for convenience.
Catalog scale never outranks quality, certification or safety.

Every published CalcuMint calculator is a Final Calculator powered by one certified deterministic calculation engine. Free, Pro and Business always receive identical mathematical correctness. Free provides the complete core calculation and useful interpretation; Pro adds advanced analysis, optimization, persistence and professional outputs; Business adds collaboration, deployment, integration, automation and governance. Technical revisions remain immutable internal audit identifiers and never become customer-facing V1/V2/V3 product releases.
Future development, migration, certification, publication, monetization and scale decisions should be tested against this statement and the locked decisions in this blueprint.
